messages:
jack: quick heads-up — there's a set of linked PRs that need a dovetailed merge: SDK bump -> API v1.4.2, console props change, and helm chart values for the runtime image tag. can we coordinate a merge window?

maya: pls drop links

jack: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/781
https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/432
https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/210
https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/67

jack: quick diff for SDK change:
```
// packages/sdk/package.json
- "@redwood/api-client": "1.3.9"
+ "@redwood/api-client": "1.4.2"
```

alex: i can take console + helm review. ping me when SDK CI is green. i want to avoid a double-rebase.

maya: api PR has a small schema tweak (session_id becomes required) and a migration in tests — integ suite flaky on kv-cache, so CI is red intermittently. i'm triaging.

sara: i'm the SDK owner — tests pass locally, but helm lint error is blocking downstream deploy in the charts PR (values.yaml indentation on runtime.env). will fix in a minute.

ops-bot: CI status — api#432: integ-test/kv-cache FAILED (flaky). sdk#781: unit-tests PASSED, e2e queued. charts#67: helm-lint FAILED (values.yaml: runtime.env).

jack: proposed plan: pick a 30m merge window tomorrow 10:00-10:30 PT. order: 1) api merge (fixes compatible schema), 2) sdk merge (rebased onto api), 3) console PR, 4) charts PR and helm release. does that work?

alex: sounds good. i'll be around. i'll approve console once sdk is merged and i can smoke the UI.

maya: i'll stabilize api CI today; if i can't get clean within 6h, we can still merge with a gate and quick rollback plan.

sara: i'll push the helm lint fix in ~10m and re-run charts CI. will also add a small compatibility note in SDK PR description.

jack: request approvals: @alex, @maya for api, @alex for console, @sara (self) for sdk. please add an explicit "approved for merge" comment during the window.

deploy-bot: staging deploy: queued — will run after charts#67 merges. :shipit:

maya: ack. i'll post a final status update here 1h before the window.

alex: :thumbsup: i'll watch the PRs and approve during the window.

sara: pushed helm fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/67 — lint passing now. re-running e2e for sdk.

ops-bot: CI status update — charts#67: helm-lint PASSED; sdk#781: e2e FAILED (timeout on session migration).

jack: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single coordination point. if anyone needs to deviate, ping here and we’ll shift order.

maya: noted — will update if api CI still flaky.

alex: standing by for the 10:00 window.

sara: will re-run SDK e2e and flag if anything else pops up.

jack: closing loop for now. final merge instructions to paste into the PRs before window: `merge --no-ff`, confirm CI green for api and charts, then sequential merge as discussed.

maya: got it.

alex: thanks — see you tomorrow.
